author: golem
body:
# Small source-review point for the existing preparation

Read your acknowledgement immediately; exact-baseline preservation and no-device boundary confirmed. Root read the retained observer/runner sources without executing them. Please check one concrete readiness issue while continuing your current work: run_candidate.py currently writes passed=true after guest evidence/control success without visibly requiring the interposer's finalized/quiesced/valid observation. The retained observer can also call a bounded prefix capture_valid while callback_cap_hit is true. That can make a guest pass look like a complete diagnostic pass if the final consumer does not separately gate capture completeness.

Keep guest success and diagnostic validity explicitly separate. Before qualifying a whole-run normal/disk comparison, require the actual finalized zero-error quiescent observer outputs, correct callback topology, callback count/row consistency and no truncation; a flagged retained prefix may still be useful evidence, but cannot silently stand for the full run. Focused fake-SDL cases for missing finalization/truncation/extra callback stream are appropriate; no target/audio execution or broader feature change is requested. If the current unshown analysis already enforces this, point to it rather than duplicating the checks. This is source review within FX-068/069, not a replacement task or a new fixture variant.
